title: Utility Billing and Assistance, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Utility Billing and Assistance agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 6 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Utility Billing and Assistance Utility Accounts list.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Patricia Hernandez (UtilityAccountId ACCT-90001), with Address 1245 Cedar Lane.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Utility Billing Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 6 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Customer Service Representative
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Explain ACCT-90003 balances without changing the account.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: ACCT-90003; $489.20; No balance. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Billing Specialist
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Does ACCT-90003 show a possible leak and what draft adjustment evidence is needed?
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: REVIEW POSSIBLE LEAK; Draft policy estimate; not a leak diagnosis. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Revenue Services Supervisor
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Show ACCT-90003 payment-plan options, but do not set one up.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: 12 months; No payment arrangement was created. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Assistance Coordinator
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Screen a two-person household earning 25000 with a 70-year-old applicant.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: POTENTIALLY ELIGIBLE; No eligibility determination; enrollment. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Utility Billing and Assistance: 6 read-only tabs from the same lists. 4 fictional records, including Patricia Hernandez (UtilityAccountId ACCT-90001), with Address 1245 Cedar Lane.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Utility Billing and Assistance Utility Accounts from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload utility-accounts.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set UtilityAccountId, Address, AccountType, Services, Status, Autopay, LastPaymentDate to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep BalanceCurrent, BalancePastDue, LastPaymentAmount as Number. Name the list Utility Billing and Assistance Utility Accounts. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Patricia Hernandez (UtilityAccountId ACCT-90001), with Address 1245 Cedar Lane.

steps.title: Create Utility Billing and Assistance Usage History from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload usage-history.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set UsageHistoryId to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Use Multiple lines of text for Value (up to 477 characters). If the import screen cannot create these long-text columns losslessly, stop and report the import limitation; do not continue with truncated records. Compare their full values with the downloaded CSV. Name the list Utility Billing and Assistance Usage History. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 2 fictional records, including ACCT-90001 (UsageHistoryId ACCT-90001).

steps.title: Create Utility Billing and Assistance Rate Structures from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload rate-structures.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set RateStructureId, Tiers to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep BaseCharge, RatePer1000, Residential, CommercialPerEru as Number. Name the list Utility Billing and Assistance Rate Structures. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including water_residential (RateStructureId water_residential), with BaseCharge 18.5.

steps.title: Create Utility Billing and Assistance Assistance Programs from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload assistance-programs.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set AssistanceProgramId, Eligibility, DocumentsRequired, Status to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep IncomeLimitPctFPL, MaxBenefit, DiscountPct, MaxInstallments as Number. Name the list Utility Billing and Assistance Assistance Programs. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Low-Income Household Water Assistance Program (AssistanceProgramId LIHWAP), with IncomeLimitPctFPL 150.

steps.title: Create Utility Billing and Assistance Leak Adjustment Policy from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload leak-adjustment-policy.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set LeakAdjustmentPolicyId, Value to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Utility Billing and Assistance Leak Adjustment Policy. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 3 fictional records, including lookback_months (LeakAdjustmentPolicyId lookback_months).

steps.title: Create Utility Billing and Assistance FPL Reference 2025 from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload fpl-reference-2025.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set FPLReference2025Id to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep Value as Number. Name the list Utility Billing and Assistance FPL Reference 2025. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 5 fictional records, including 1 (FPLReference2025Id 1), with Value 15650.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Utility Billing Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Utility Billing and Assistance Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the six list tools, and end with your site's address.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload utility-billing-assistance-rules-and-controls.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the utility accounts tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Utility Billing and Assistance Utility Accounts; name the tool Get utility account records.
steps.expected: Get utility account records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the usage history tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Utility Billing and Assistance Usage History; name the tool Get usage history records.
steps.expected: Get usage history records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the assistance programs tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Utility Billing and Assistance Assistance Programs; name the tool Get assistance program records.
steps.expected: Get assistance program records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the leak adjustment policy tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Utility Billing and Assistance Leak Adjustment Policy; name the tool Get leak adjustment policy records.
steps.expected: Get leak adjustment policy records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the fpl reference 2025 tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Utility Billing and Assistance FPL Reference 2025; name the tool Get fpl reference 2025 records.
steps.expected: Get fpl reference 2025 records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 6 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 6 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: utility-billing-assistance-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 6 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Utility Billing Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Utility Billing and Assistance Utility Accounts" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Utility Billing and Assistance Usage History" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Utility Billing and Assistance Rate Structures" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Utility Billing and Assistance Assistance Programs" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Utility Billing and Assistance Leak Adjustment Policy" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Utility Billing and Assistance FPL Reference 2025" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 6 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Utility Billing and Assistance Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Utility Billing and Assistance Utility Accounts tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 4 fictional records, including Patricia Hernandez (UtilityAccountId ACCT-90001), with Address 1245 Cedar Lane.
